parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the microwave is made of stainless steel, forming the main structural body that houses all internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, shielding, and protection for the internal electronics and cooking chamber.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door of the microwave is made of tempered glass and plastic, forming the front access panel for the cooking chamber.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to open and close the microwave, providing access to the interior while maintaining safety and radiation shielding when closed.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about a hinge on one side, allowing it to open and close smoothly.
